decisions_requested.statement: Approve a strictly scoped L02 extension of NE for predicate negation inside the STR005 course frame only; retain NE authority as CANDIDATE and create no universal negation grammar.
Approve AN as the scoped first-person referent component for STR005 only; retain AN authority as CANDIDATE and create no global person paradigm.
Confirm AN + NE + PREDICATE is not sufficient by itself to satisfy canonical 'I didn't...' because no governed past context is present.
Approve PA + AN + NE + PREDICATE as the preferred exact scoped course candidate only for an explicitly yesterday-anchored realization such as 'Yesterday, I didn't [predicate]'.
Keep PA strictly lexical 'ontem'; approval of PAT-B must not establish PA=PAST, generic tense morphology, a DID auxiliary, or universal sentence-initial temporal syntax.
Restrict predicate instantiation to already governed L02 predicates; use VALI as the preferred first example and do not invent a new predicate to complete STR005.
Do not use SAROSARI as the first STR005 example because its bare-predicate use remains HIGH risk and its OPI-006 yes/no response branch remains blocked.
Confirm any selected STR005 pattern remains a scoped SimpleWay course frame and does not establish universal declarative word order or negative-past grammar.
Keep VANI/VANUVALI unresolved and all WATCH/CANDIDATE/FROZEN authorities unchanged.
If approved, apply the scoped NE extension and select PAT-B for STR005 design, but keep L02-STR-005 MISSING until a separate explicit STR005 authoring gate.
Keep the prepared 15-slot SQS validation batch deferred; this pattern gate does not validate any existing authored slot.
Create no new surface form, lexeme, authority promotion, generic past rule, or validation state from this pattern approval alone.
